feeds.title: Eating Bird Food
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Brittany, the creator of Eating Bird Food. I live in Richmond, Virginia with my husband, Isaac, our daughter, Olivia, and cute pup. Eating Bird Food simply means eating a wholesome diet focused on real food - without labels. I'm drawn toward plant-based options, but I also eat fish and lean meat so that's the type of recipes you'll find here.

feeds.title: Diabetic Foodie Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Shelby Kinnaird to help people eat healthy, local, diabetic-friendly food that tastes great, diabetic diet.Diabetic Foodie is run by people living with diabetes and all the recipes are created with blood sugar management, as well as our tastebuds, in mind.

feeds.title: Cookwith5Kids
feeds.description: Sara LaFountain is the owner and creator of the blog Cook With 5 Kids. This blog originated as an online recipe box in 2010. Sara is Mom to four boys and one little girl. You will usually find their family in the kitchen. When they are not cooking they love to play board games, take photographs, play video games, and use the latest technology.
